messages.subject: Larkfield (Project Polaris) — earn-out query
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Unrelated to Drake — on Project Polaris (the Larkfield spa acquisition), the FY2025 numbers are firming up and it looks like the earn-out will pay out near the top of the range. Can someone confirm the long-stop date for the earn-out determination under that SPA? No rush, just planning cash. Thanks.

Nathan
